entry.title: ProstoCAD 0.12.0: InnCad Plus is now ProstoCAD — plus Delete for dimensions, rectangle diagonals and a smoother Symmetric
entry.content:
Added

  • A new name, the same program: your files open as before, and on its first start ProstoCAD takes over InnCad Plus's settings by itself.
  • Every rectangle gets its two diagonals and a centre point as construction: one constraint (the centre on the origin) centres it. A rounded rectangle's diagonals join its corner centres.
  • Right-click in a sketch offers Delete for whatever is selected, dimensions too; Parameters can delete a sketch dimension.

Fixed

  • After Symmetric the lines could not be dragged: the tool now ends once the pair is made.

entry.title: ProstoCAD for FreeCAD 0.13.0: InCad is now ProstoCAD for FreeCAD — plus Delete for dimensions, rectangle diagonals and a smoother Symmetric
entry.content:
Added

  • A new name, the same workbench: in FreeCAD it shows as ProstoCAD, and every file made before opens as it did.
  • Every rectangle gets its two diagonals and a centre point as construction: one constraint (the centre on the origin) centres it. A rounded rectangle's diagonals join its corner centres.
  • Right-click in a sketch offers Delete for whatever is selected, dimensions too; Parameters can delete a sketch dimension.

Fixed

  • After Symmetric the lines could not be dragged: the tool now ends once the pair is made.
